 Hannah Moore Wed, November 4, 2026 at 12:09 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. LOUDON, Tenn. (WATE) — It's Election Day in Loudon County, and voters are deciding who will win in several key races.
 Residents have the opportunity to vote for Tennessee's next governor and on three proposed amendments to the state constitution, as well as for various State House and Senate seats. Voters in London and Greenback will also decide their next mayor.
 The polls closed at 8 p.m., and results will be updated periodically.
